commenti.body: Hated it (and I love Michael Mann films), driver was miscast, he’s too young, has to distinctive a look to be an old Italian man, I didn’t care about his personal life whatsoever. The film should have been in Italian (like Eastwood’s Iwo Jima was in Japanese) or if not they should have cast Michael Imperioli as Ferrari at least. The film was not atmospheric like Heat, Thief, or Miami Vice. Was boring and I simply didn’t care about Ferrari’s life. How was this an art film???

Miscasting thing cah be a solid critique, but from what you have written, I don't think you'd be caring even if an italian actor has been chosen (which I totally agree on this). 

Film was atmospheric. I don't agree on this one. Sorry.

I understand and totally got your casting critique but I don't think casting is the reason that you didn't like the film, because Driver is a brilliant actor. He gives so much for the role, but agreed miscasting.
Driver is a good actor, don’t get me wrong but he was miscast. He has too distinctive of a look to be Enzo Ferrari. I saw nothing atmospheric in Ferrari.

>Frankly, as someone who watched easily some more than a thousand films, it's quite hard to impress me these recent years. 

Has to be the most embarrassing way to start a review I've seen on here.
Thank you! I wrote how I feel.

I wrote it especially because recent years film industry became something really just trite and every time I see newly made blockbuster films, I get tired. And it occurred to me that they are not impressing me and earlier I never liked to state it, but then I got tired of same films recycling over and over again and started blatantly say it that most of them don't impress me. 

Again, thank you! ❤️

Really didnt enjoy this one. It didn’t feel like it had a consistent direction and was a bit all over the place with its focus. Also - maybe this is silly and nitpicking, but I hated the accents. An almost impressive amount of effort is put in to make it appear 1950s italy, and then everyone speaks almost caricatured heavily accented English. I doubt being an italian language film would have saved it, but it bothered me throughout

Yes, I see your point. I didn't watch it in original language unfortunately. It was dubbed, so I can't really talk about accents. But for sure gonna watch it in original in a year, I would say. Maybe you are right about the accent thing. 🤝🏻
